RENAME THIS FILE TO: gradle-wrapper.properties

(It ships as .txt only because the packaging sandbox reserves the exact
"gradle-wrapper.properties" name. Android Studio also regenerates the full
Gradle wrapper automatically on first project sync, so you can simply open
the project and let the IDE create it, or run:

    gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.9

networkTimeout=10000
validateDistributionUrl=true
